div.span:
Looking in from 50 Ω side: 86.6 ∥ (43.2 + 75) = 50.0 Ω
Looking in from 75 Ω side: 43.2 + (86.6 ∥ 50) = 74.9 Ω
Insertion loss: 5.7 dB (the price of a resistive match)
